name: book-to-skill
tagline: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill
description: book-to-skill converts a technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill that you can study, reference, and use while you work. Instead of leaving knowledge trapped in a static PDF, the tool packages the book's content into a skill structure Claude Code can load on demand — turning a textbook into an always-available reference for active coding sessions. It is Python-based and aims to make deep technical reference material directly usable by AI coding agents.
highlights: Packages a technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill for on-demand reference
Lets agents study and use the book's knowledge while working, not just search it
19.7k stars shows the hunger for agent-ready reference material
Python tooling designed for practical workflows
curatorNote: This is the pattern everyone will copy in the next year: books as agent skills instead of PDFs. 19k stars in a few months says authors and readers alike see the shift coming.
